title: Parallel routes with catch-all segments cause error "could not find the module in the React Client Manifest"

labels.name: bug
labels.description: Issue was opened via the bug report template.

labels.name: Linking and Navigating

body:
### Link to the code that reproduces this issue https://codesandbox.io/p/devbox/stoic-booth-mqhx92 ### To Reproduce Have a Next app with some parallel routes with catch-all segments, where some parallel route page.tsx files import components, possibly including non-default exports. Example structure: ``` /app layout.tsx /[locale] layout.tsx /dashboard layout.tsx /@header /[...dir] /components MyLink.tsx page.tsx /[instanceId] layout.tsx /home page.tsx ``` with this file content, and otherwise minimal content as normal: ``` // app/[locale]/dashboard/layout.tsx export default function DashboardLayout({ children, header }) { return (
{header}
{children}
) } // app/[locale]/dashboard/@header/page.tsx import MyLink, { BonusLink } from "./components/page.tsx" export default function Header() { return (
) } // app/[locale]/dashboard/@header/components/MyLink.tsx import Link from "next/link" export function BonusLink({ href }) { return Bonus link } export default function MyLink({ href }) { return Linky link } ``` 1. Run the Next dev server **without Turbopack** 2. Navigate to `/en/dashboard/abc123/home` 3. Errors ### Current vs. Expected behavior Expected behavior: should render the page + parallel routes according to the layout tree. Actual behavior: errors about not finding modules in the React Client Manifest: ``` ✓ Compiled /[locale]/dashboard/[instanceId]/home in 1201ms (488 modules) ⨯ Error: Could not find the module "/workspaces/workspace/app/[locale]/dashboard/@header/components/MyLink.tsx#" in the React Client Manifest. This is probably a bug in the React Server Components bundler. at stringify () ⨯ Error: Could not find the module "/workspaces/workspace/app/[locale]/dashboard/@header/components/MyLink.tsx#BonusLink" in the React Client Manifest. This is probably a bug in the React Server Components bundler. at stringify () ⨯ Error: Could not find the module "/workspaces/workspace/app/[locale]/dashboard/@header/components/MyLink.tsx#" in the React Client Manifest. This is probably a bug in the React Server Components bundler. at stringify () digest: "1645395023" ⨯ Internal error: Error: Could not find the module "/workspaces/workspace/node_modules/next/dist/client/link.js#" in the React Client Manifest. This is probably a bug in the React Server Components bundler. at /workspaces/workspace/node_modules/next/dist/compiled/next-server/app-page.runtime.dev.js:35:263710 at eN (/workspaces/workspace/node_modules/next/dist/compiled/next-server/app-page.runtime.dev.js:35:263905) at /workspaces/workspace/node_modules/next/dist/compiled/next-server/app-page.runtime.dev.js:35:278460 at Array.toJSON (/workspaces/workspace/node_modules/next/dist/compiled/next-server/app-page.runtime.dev.js:35:279650) at stringify () at /workspaces/workspace/node_modules/next/dist/compiled/next-server/app-page.runtime.dev.js:35:266006 at ez (/workspaces/workspace/node_modules/next/dist/compiled/next-server/app-page.runtime.dev.js:35:266085) at eH (/workspaces/workspace/node_modules/next/dist/compiled/next-server/app-page.runtime.dev.js:35:266486) at Timeout._onTimeout (/workspaces/workspace/node_modules/next/dist/compiled/next-server/app-page.runtime.dev.js:35:262984) at listOnTimeout (node:internal/timers:573:17) at process.processTimers (node:internal/timers:514:7) ``` Note: it seems to work fine with Turbopack enabled, but I can't use it in my app yet because it lacks full Sass support. ### Verify canary release - [X] I verified that the issue exists in the latest Next.js canary release ### Provide environment information ```bash Operating System: Platform: linux Arch: arm64 Version: #1 SMP PREEMPT Tue Oct 10 20:38:06 UTC 2023 Binaries: Node: 20.9.0 npm: 10.2.5 Yarn: 1.22.19 pnpm: 8.10.2 Relevant Packages: next: 14.0.4 eslint-config-next: 13.4.1 react: 18.2.0 react-dom: 18.2.0 typescript: 5.0.3 ``` ### Which area(s) are affected? (Select all that apply) App Router, Dynamic imports (next/dynamic), Routing (next/router, next/navigation, next/link) ### Additional context Side note - I'm only trying to do this because `@parallel/default.tsx` doesn't seem to work with nested dynamic routes, or something like that; the parallel routes 404 rather than fall back to their `default.tsx`. I haven't been able to narrow down that issue to a report that meets the criteria, though. I'd prefer to use a structure like this, which seems fine by the docs but doesn't work on routes not matched by a specific page.tsx: ``` /dashboard layout.tsx /@header default.tsx <-- shown for everything that doesn't have a matching page.tsx /[instanceId] /page-with-different-header page.tsx <-- only shown for this particular route ``` [NEXT-1908](https://linear.app/vercel/issue/NEXT-1908/parallel-routes-with-catch-all-segments-cause-error-could-not-find-the)
